packages.problem: Safe owner training tasks can be quarantined when safety_rules use safe-intent but noncanonical field names.
evidence: observed owner task quarantine reason unsafe_live_task_safety_rules
packages.risk: Weakening the safety gate could admit accepted-state or commit requests if not tested with unsafe negatives.
packages.proposed_validator_scenario: Canonical safe, safe-intent alternate, expected_outputs, plan_steps, and unsafe mutation tasks classify with explicit field reasons.

packages.problem: Owner tasks can be delayed behind internal active tasks and backlog advancement is tied to owner-promotion wait state.
packages.risk: Preempting internal tasks incorrectly could discard useful work or duplicate candidates.
packages.proposed_validator_scenario: With internal active task plus safe owner task, owner task is backlogged, then advanced predictably without loss after current task reaches a clear handoff state.

packages.problem: Quality counters can disagree when scripts count legacy candidate_quality/quality_result.json instead of quality_gate/quality_gate_result.json.
packages.risk: A superficial counter fix could hide missing quality records instead of reconciling artifact namespaces.
packages.proposed_validator_scenario: A fixture with one ready candidate proves candidate quality file count, quality_gate record count, console counters, and promotion_manifest decisions agree or declare the designed alias.

packages.problem: Route locks still contain active-looking PHASE91-PHASE105 and PHASE107-PHASE111 signals while accepted runtime is PHASE160H1.
packages.risk: Silently retiring locks would erase route history; keeping stale locks active misroutes operators.
packages.proposed_validator_scenario: Route audit identifies active, exhausted, superseded, and archived locks and requires an explicit PHASE161 route request before state changes.

packages.problem: Overnight Builder School needs a linked lifecycle runner, morning review report, stop/archive/clean flow, and failure clustering after the preceding repairs.
packages.risk: Launching school before lifecycle repairs would create unreviewable overnight work and ambiguous owner-task handling.
packages.proposed_validator_scenario: Batch-school dry run executes several safe tasks unattended, clusters failures, writes morning report, and proves no accepted repo mutation.
